summary: Swept four backend core modules (config, database, lifespan, main), none of which had an owner test. I created four test files. All 22 new tests pass, and the full backend suite (70 tests) and the backend typecheck pass. Line and branch coverage reached 100% for each target.

targets.reason: No owner test existed. dotenv is mocked and every env variable is stubbed, so results do not depend on a local .env. Coverage 100%.
behaviours: loads the repository root .env quietly on import
builds a postgresql URL from the five POSTGRES/DB_PORT variables
reports each missing variable by name when it is empty
prefers an explicit DATABASE_URL or override and rewrites the postgresql+psycopg scheme
percent-encodes credentials and the database name

targets.reason: No owner test existed. initialize() is tested with a spy on $executeRaw on a client aimed at a closed port. Coverage 100%. The SQL text is checked, but drift from prisma/schema.prisma needs an integration test.
behaviours: initialize runs one raw statement that creates the todos table with no interpolated values
the statement includes the priority and non-empty-title check constraints
initialize propagates a rejection from the database

targets.reason: No owner test existed. createDatabase is mocked with a fake client, signal handlers are captured, and the server listens on port 0. Coverage 100%.
behaviours: connects before creating the schema, listens on API_PORT, logs the port and registers SIGTERM and SIGINT handlers
listens on port 8000 on 0.0.0.0 by default
closes the server and disconnects on SIGTERM and SIGINT
forces process.exit(1) after 10 seconds if shutdown hangs
logs a failed disconnect and sets exitCode 1
disconnects and rethrows when $connect or the schema creation fails
fails before creating a client when the database is not configured

targets.reason: No owner test existed. start is mocked with vi.doMock and the module is imported dynamically. Coverage 100%.
behaviours: logs 'Cannot start Taskly App Node API:' with the error and sets exitCode 1 when start rejects
calls start once on import without error output when it resolves
